info.name: Baserow API spec Admin Admin data scanner API

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of data scan results IDs to filter by. When provided, only data scan results with those IDs are returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Defines which page should be returned.

params.name: search
params.description: If provided only data scan results with matched_value that match the query will be returned.

params.name: size
params.description: Defines how many data scan results should be returned per page.

params.name: sorts
params.description: A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `first_identified_on, last_identified_on`. For example `sorts=-first_identified_on,-last_identified_on` will sort the data scan results first by descending first_identified_on and then ascending last_identified_on. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error.

items.docs: Lists all data scan results across all scans. Results represent individual matches found in database fields during scan execution. Can be filtered by scan_id and searched by matched value. **Enterprise feature.**
Deletes (resolves) a single data scan result, marking it as reviewed. **Enterprise feature.**

Creates a job to export data scan results to CSV. The exported file includes scan name, workspace, database, table, field, row ID, matched value, and timestamps for each result. **Enterprise feature.**

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of data scans IDs to filter by. When provided, only data scans with those IDs are returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Defines which page should be returned.

params.name: search
params.description: If provided only data scans with name that match the query will be returned.

params.name: size
params.description: Defines how many data scans should be returned per page.

params.name: sorts
params.description: A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `name, scan_type, frequency, created_on`. For example `sorts=-name,-scan_type` will sort the data scans first by descending name and then ascending scan_type. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error.

items.docs: Lists all data scans configured for this Baserow instance. Data scans allow administrators to search the entire instance for sensitive data matching a pattern, a list of uploaded values, or values from another Baserow table. **Enterprise feature.**

Creates a new data scan. A data scan searches the Baserow instance for sensitive data matching a pattern (e.g. credit card numbers), a list of uploaded values, or values sourced from another Baserow table. **Enterprise feature.**
Returns a single data scan configuration. **Enterprise feature.**
Updates a data scan configuration. When the scan type, pattern, or list items change, stale results are automatically cleaned up. **Enterprise feature.**
Deletes a data scan and all of its results. **Enterprise feature.**
Triggers an immediate run of the given data scan. The scan executes asynchronously and searches the configured workspaces for matches. **Enterprise feature.**
Returns the database/table/field structure of a workspace for use in data scan configuration. Only text-compatible fields are included. **Enterprise feature.**
